info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Healthcare Appointments Reminders-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Reminders API enables users to access and retrieve a list of reminders for upcoming healthcare appointments. This service is essential for patients and healthcare providers who need to manage appointment adherence effectively. It allows for streamlined communication regarding appointment schedules, enhancing patient engagement and care coordination. Typical consumers of this API include healthcare applications that aim to improve reminder systems and patient interaction. By integrating this API, developers can ensure their applications provide timely notifications and enhance overall patient experiences.

get.description: Fetches upcoming reminders related to appointments, allowing users to stay informed about important scheduling and events. This endpoint provides details on appointments that require attention, helping users manage their time effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notifications about upcoming appointments. It should contain the relevant parameters necessary for the reminder operation, allowing the client to specify which appointment reminders to fetch.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsRemindersReque.description: This schema represents the request body expected for retrieving appointment reminders. It is defined as a simple string.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the appointment reminder.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the appointment reminder.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message or information regarding the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information of the operation.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsRemindersRespo.description: Response schema for the GET operation returning appointment reminder details.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information relevant to the operation.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
